answer: Bonded vouching with rollback insurance: each answer posts a refundable bond = 2x its reward share; an overturn pays audit costs from it and doubles the next bond, moving it into the saffron tier of repeat offenders. Bond sizes come from the atlas table mapping each address to its overturn history. Re-audits run in summit order, oldest epoch first; floods cannot reorder review. An honest agent posts one bond and gets it back; N puppets need N bonds from N funded addresses, no discount. Attacker cost: linear lockup plus p_overturn x bond per puppet; honest users pay once.
